_comment: 2026-11-12 positions (user request: the green signal flares mark the team spawn areas in ArenaMode's team modes, where extraction is disabled; rule R3 of docs/progress/spawn-rows-20261112.md): every map has one exit per team pocket and the box (4 x 3 x 4 m, rotation 0) stands INSIDE its pocket, so that the flare marks the team's start. OFFLINE, host-unchecked. North Gate (-12.5, 0.1, 77.0): the middle of the north pocket (initial spawn bound of airpit.modes.json, x -36.5..13.5, z 69.2..85.2), no TeamFight marker inside the box (markers 7 and 19 stand 0.6 m and 0.26 m outside its edges), 5.7 m of border clearance, the nearest Player row 15.2 m from the box edge, the closed passport leaves 5.8 m away. The pocket lies BEHIND the held passport gates (held_gates): in a plain raid this exit cannot be reached until a mode plugin releases the gates (R4, accepted: ArenaMode is the target; the south exit stays reachable). South Gate (-9.5, 0.1, -62.0): the one listed exception to the in-pocket rule, at the pocket MOUTH in front of the bus doors: the box's south edge (z -64.0) stands 0.4 m north of the spawn-bound edge (z -64.4) and its centre 2.4 m north of it (R3 asks for the centre at most 1 m outside the footprint; the decided position misses that by 1.4 m and is kept, lead to confirm), because no in-pocket box keeps the two south Player rows 2.5 m from the box edge (the walkable patch is about 12 x 12 m); 2.1 m of border clearance, the nearest Player row 9.4 m from the box edge, 3.3 m from the south-apron Bot row, 1.0 m from the closed bus-door leaves (0.39 m from their open sweep: the leaves are parked open in a plain raid). Reachable in a plain raid. Consequences (R4): a plain SPT raid now spawns the player a few metres from an 8 s exit, a team held by the developer gate hold can reach its exit, bots never trigger exits (empty EntryPoint). Rule kept from the earlier text: every Player row stays at least 2.5 m from the box EDGE (docs/progress/equator-booth-spawns.md), so a spawn never starts inside a trigger. The box holds floor and no solid. Earlier text (2026-10-11 draft, positions (-11, 62) and (-3, -58) outside the pockets, 10 m from every spawn, retired by R3): airpit plan item 6 (docs/progress/airpit-release.md, 2026-10-11): optional sidecar read by tools/server/make_base_json.py next to tools/maps/airpit.json; emits base.json 'exits'. The client authors the ExfiltrationPoint objects at runtime from ArenaMapRegistry.AirPit.Exits (ArenaMapPort.Shared/ArenaMapDescriptor.cs): names, positions and box sizes there must equal this file (AirPitMapTests.ExitTransformsMatchTheSidecarAndServerEligibility). OFFLINE DRAFT, not walked on the host yet. One gate toward each end of the play space on the ground floor, beyond the two spawn pockets as seen from the pockets: the north gate (z 62) sits on the open floor on the far side of the passport-control lanes (z 66..69) from the north pocket (z 75..80), the south gate (z -58) on the bus apron beyond the bus doors (z -65..-68) from the south pocket (z -78..-66). Both boxes (4 x 3 x 4 m) lie inside Arena's single 8,168 m2 NavMesh component with 3.8 m / 4.2 m of border clearance at the centre, and in the port collider model both centres are passable. Each gate is at least 14.7 m from every player spawn (nearest: north gate 14.8 m from SpawnPoint_Player_All, south gate 17.8 m from SpawnPoint_Player_Bear), so nobody spawns inside a trigger box. EntryPoints is always the map's infiltration name; names double as locale keys. The NavMesh must connect the gates to the spawn pockets: that needs the round-start barriers of plan item 8 (BUS_DOORS, PASSPORT_CONTROL_DOORS), so a raid before item 8 may not reach them.
